payload.description: Reorder six RUF036 unions and bound the dev ruff pin so an upstream release cannot redden CI

payload.reason: Both automated sources remain unavailable on main: the claude-cli $schema fix is still unmerged (PR #87, blocked by exactly this lint breakage), and the codex model pin is stale by operator decision. Micro tier with zero design surface: six annotation reorderings that are type-identical at runtime (X|None|Y == X|Y|None) plus one dependency upper bound. Root cause is mechanically verified — local ruff 0.15.14 reports 'All checks passed!' on the same tree CI reddens, and the six sites predate every branch in flight. This is the second consecutive disclosed plan-review skip; both trace to the same review-infrastructure outage this chain of cuts is unblocking.

Same review-infrastructure outage as the plan stage, and on THIS branch it is structural: the branch is cut from main, where claude_cli.py still carries the $schema defect (its fix sits unmerged in PR #87, blocked by exactly the lint breakage this cut repairs), and the codex model pin remains stale by operator decision. Evidence in lieu of a reviewer: all six edits are annotation ORDER only and type-identical at runtime; the ruff bound is a dependency range; verified with the NEWEST ruff in an isolated environment (uvx ruff@latest -> 'All checks passed!'), not merely the local 0.15.14 that cannot see RUF036 at all; mypy clean over 118 files; full suite 2098 passed unchanged. Third consecutive disclosed skip in this chain — all three trace to one root outage, and merging this is what restores real review.
